import json
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    ys=[y for y in range(h) if all(v==3 for v in g[y])]
    xs=[x for x in range(w) if all(g[y][x]==3 for y in range(h))]
    dys=[-(y+1) for y in ys]
    dxs=[-(x+1) for x in xs]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    from itertools import product
    shifts=[(0,0)]+[(dy,dx) for dy in dys for dx in ([0]+dxs)]+[(0,dx) for dx in dxs]
    for dy,dx in set(shifts):
        if dy==0 and dx==0: continue
        for y in range(h):
            for x in range(w):
                v=g[y][x]
                if v not in (0,2,3,5):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and out[ny][nx] in (2,5):
                        out[ny][nx]=v
    return out

code = '''from collections import Counter

def transform(g):
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    cnt = Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    ys = [y for y in range(h) if len(set(g[y])) == 1 and g[y][0] != bg]
    xs = [x for x in range(w) if len({g[y][x] for y in range(h)}) == 1 and g[0][x] != bg]
    lc = {g[y][0] for y in ys} | {g[0][x] for x in xs}
    shifts = [(0, 0)]
    shifts += [( -(y + 1), 0) for y in ys]
    shifts += [(0, -(x + 1)) for x in xs]
    shifts += [( -(y + 1), -(x + 1)) for y in ys for x in xs]
    out = [row[:] for row in g]
    for dy, dx in set(shifts):
        for y in range(h):
            for x in range(w):
                v = g[y][x]
                if v != bg and v not in lc:
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and out[ny][nx] == bg:
                        out[ny][nx] = v
    return out
'''
